_note: The DSX Scene MODEL corpus (dsx-scene.md P4): GLB → the parsed model. THE LAW: `<model src>` consumes glTF 2.0 BINARY containers (GLB) — 12-byte header (magic 0x46546C67, version 2, total length), a JSON chunk (0x4E4F534A), and an optional BIN chunk (0x004E4942). v1 reads EMBEDDED buffers only — a buffer with a `uri` (external .bin or data URI) is the NAMED ABSENCE, error code 'external-buffer'. Supported per primitive: POSITION (f32 VEC3, required), NORMAL (f32 VEC3, optional — absent normals come back empty and the renderer flat-shades from the triangle winding), indices (u8/u16/u32 SCALAR; a non-indexed primitive synthesizes 0..n-1), material `pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor` (default [1,1,1,1]), triangle mode (4, the default) only. The DRAW LIST flattens the default scene's node hierarchy: a node's local matrix is its `matrix` (column-major, the corpus mat4 layout verbatim) or T · R(quaternion x y z w) · S from translation/rotation/scale (defaults 0 0 0 · identity · 1 1 1); world = parentWorld · local, and every node that references a mesh contributes one draw {mesh, world}. The renderer then applies model = sceneWorld · draw.world (the P1 model = world · S(geometry) law, with the glTF node transform playing the geometry-local role). FAILURE IS A VALUE (Article 7): a malformed container parses to an error code, never a throw — 'not-glb' (bad magic/header), 'external-buffer' (the named absence), 'malformed' (anything structurally broken past the header). Case shape: `fixture` names an entry in `fixtures` (base64 GLB bytes, byte layout documented in README.md); `expect` asserts a SUBSET — meshCount/drawCount, `meshes` entries ({index, vertexCount, indexCount, positions, normals, indices, baseColor} — fields address PRIMITIVE 0 of mesh[index]; positions/normals flat xyz to 6 decimals), `draws` entries ({index, mesh, world: 16 column-major floats}), `transformed` entries ({draw, vertex, world}: draws[draw].world applied to that primitive-0 vertex, w=1); `error` asserts the code instead. Expected numbers were computed by an independent scratch implementation (scratch build_glb.py), never by a kernel under test. Runners: TS (per-PR), Kotlin (:core). Swift is the NAMED P4 follow-up (dsx-scene.md P4 row) — this file is the ledger entry until it lands.
